guidance.said: Our target of yearly investment continues to be the same at about INR25,000 crores.
guidance.quote: So that's why our target of yearly investment continues to be the same. And there may be certain deferment by a quarter or 2. But otherwise, we are very much on track.
guidance.speaker: Praveer Sinha

guidance.said: We are looking at commissioning about 1.5 to 1.8 gigawatts of solar and wind combined in the current year.
guidance.quote: So solar would be about 1.5 to 1.8.
guidance.speaker: Sanjeev Churiwala

guidance.said: AT&C losses for Odisha DISCOMs will come in the 12% to 13% range in the next 4 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: Based on that, we do expect that all of them will come in 12% to 13% range in the next 4 to 5 years. So, you can expect that you will reduce about 2% every year
guidance.speaker: Praveer Sinha

reported.quote: And we have, for the first time, have reported a full year PAT of nearly more than INR5,000 crores.
And the EBITDA, which has also gone up by nearly 11% to INR16,090 crores because of the strong performance of our existing businesses
During the quarter also, we have seen our EBITDA has jumped by nearly 10% to INR4,216 crores compared to INR3,829 crores last year.
PAT has gone up by 8% to INR1,416 crores compared to INR1,306 crores last year in the same quarter.
On the balance sheet also, I find that our debt is at approximately INR56,000 crores.
And this is in spite of a capital expenditure of nearly INR13,000 crores in the last financial year.

business: Tata Power Company Limited operates in the power sector, engaging in power generation, transmission, distribution, and renewable energy. Its segments include utility-scale and rooftop renewables, solar cell and module manufacturing, power distribution across multiple circles including Odisha and Delhi, and conventional thermal and hydro generation.
